description: This file defines the DockIconManager class in Swift, which manages the visibility of the application's Dock icon on macOS. It observes window state changes and user preferences to determine whether the Dock icon should be shown or hidden, and provides methods to update or temporarily show the Dock icon.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the visibility state of the application's Dock icon on macOS by observing window visibility and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Adjusts the application's Dock icon visibility based on window state and user preferences.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the app's activation policy to show the Dock icon.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Sets up observers for window changes and user defaults changes to trigger visibility updates.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Triggered when window visibility-related notifications are received; updates Dock visibility accordingly.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to user preferences that influence Dock icon visibility.
